grammar.summary: 本课以「恩得利农场闹鬼」的真相为线索，重点运用了过去完成时、who 引导的定语从句以及分词短语作状语。体会作者如何用过去完成时表达「先于过去的动作」、用 who 补充被隐藏的弟弟身份、用分词短语描写埃里克日宿夜作的状态。

points.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect)
points.explanation: had + 过去分词表示「先于过去某一时间点」已完成的动作。本课多次用过去完成时交代「被隐藏」的往事：had been obliged to join the army（被迫参军先于逃亡）、had been killed in action（谎称阵亡先于当下叙述）、had kept for over fifty years（保守秘密先于揭露）。

examples.en: After the funeral, Joe and Bob revealed a secret which they had kept for over fifty years.
examples.cn: 葬礼之后，乔和鲍勃透露了他们保守了长达50多年的秘密。

examples.en: His father told everybody that Eric had been killed in action.
examples.cn: 他的父亲告诉大家，埃里克在战争中被打死了。

points.title: who 引导的定语从句 (Relative Clauses with who)
points.explanation: who 引导定语从句修饰表示人的先行词，在从句中作主语。本课用 who 修饰 a farm worker（彻夜未眠的雇工）、a third brother（人们以为早逝的三弟），揭示「鬼」的真实身份。

examples.en: A farm worker, who stayed up all night claimed to have seen a figure cutting corn in the moonlight.
examples.cn: 有一个彻夜未眠的雇工还声称他看见一个人影在月光下收割庄稼。

examples.en: the 'ghost' was none other than Eric Cox, a third brother who was supposed to have died as a young man.
examples.cn: 那「鬼」不是别人，正是农场主的兄弟埃里克·考科斯。人们以为埃里克年轻时就死了。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrase as Adverbial)
points.explanation: 现在分词短语可作状语表示伴随状态，逻辑主语与句子主语一致。本课用 quite unaware of the fact 作伴随状语，描写埃里克日宿夜作、浑然不知自己已成了「鬼」，增添神秘与讽刺色彩。

examples.en: He used to sleep during the day and work at night, quite unaware of the fact that he had become the ghost of Endley.
examples.cn: 他白天睡觉，夜里出来干活，一点不知道自己已成了恩得利家场的活鬼。

examples.en: Fearing the authorities, Eric remained in hiding after the war as well.
examples.cn: 由于害怕当局，埃里克战后继续深藏不露。

exercises.q: After the funeral, Joe and Bob revealed a secret which they ______ for over fifty years.（用过去完成时）
A farm worker, ______ stayed up all night claimed to have seen a figure cutting corn in the moonlight.
He used to sleep during the day and work at night, quite ______ of the fact that he had become the ghost of Endley.（用分词作伴随状语）
用动词的适当形式填空：Farm labourers said that they always woke up to find that work ______ (do) overnight.
课文中 the 'ghost' was none other than Eric Cox 的 none other than 意思是？
